# Design point P022

## Description

The system would use an operationally proven Git hosting and acceleration approach while scaling read-only Git throughput by adding an arbitrary number of replicas. The selected values are compatible, although the proven operational philosophy would need to govern managing and maintaining the expanded replica fleet.
